Fist Shah is a dwarven fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three.
“
They just keep coming. Send them to Amn, make them Athkatla's problem.
„
— Shah, talking to Elin

Involvement

Shah is stationed together with  Fist Gai,  Blaze Elin and three  Steel Watchers at the bridge leading from Wyrm's Crossing into Wyrm's Rock Fortress. They guard the entrance, preventing from entering the fortress (and, by extension, the Lower City of Baldur's Gate) anyone except those who have a sufficient reason to pass. Shah is reluctant to discuss anything with the party, sending them to Elin to try to obtain permission to pass.

After gaining access to Wyrm’s Rock Fortress (by any method or path), Shah treats the party as other citizens eligible to cross their checkpoint in any direction.
